notes: Tier III carrier-neutral colocation/cloud data center in Zone Industrielle Enfidha II (Lots N47-48, Enfidha, Sousse governorate), near Enfidha-Hammamet airport and Tunis-Sousse highway; first sovereign cloud provider in Tunisia, N-Cloud labeled, ISO 27001/PCI-DSS; initial ~250 m2 hall expandable to ~1,000 m2; ~1 MW installed power; founded 2011; partners incl.
